Corner Loaf opens at 6 a.m. every day. Flour comes only in whole 10-kg sacks at $23 per sack. A 10-kg sack of rye flour costs $26. If the two bakeries place one joint order with just enough whole sacks to cover 7 days of baking, how many dollars does the order cost?

Ashford and Hollin are 552 km apart by rail. A freight train leaves Ashford for Hollin at 7:30 a.m. and runs at a steady 96 km/h. A passenger train leaves Hollin for Ashford at 8:15 a.m. on the other track and runs at a steady 1600 meters per minute. The freight train has 11 carriages. A one-way ticket between the two towns costs $38. Neither train stops on the way. How many kilometers from Hollin are the trains when they pass each other?

A survey asked 500 residents about three things. The survey took 5 weeks to complete. 18% of them own a car, 23% own a bicycle, and 27% own a scooter. The average age of those surveyed was 34. How many of the 500 residents own exactly one of the three?

This week Diego worked 44 hours, Amara worked 5 hours fewer than Diego, and Mateo worked 564 minutes on each of 5 days. Amara has worked there for 4 years. Staff get 10% off anything they buy at the bakery. How many dollars does the bakery pay the three of them in total for this week?

Elstow and Ashford are 331 km apart by rail. A local train leaves Elstow for Ashford at 10:40 a.m. and runs at a steady 68 km/h. The local train has 9 carriages. A rental shop has only bicycles, tricycles and quad bikes for hire. Quad bikes are charged $11 per hour each. A courier firm runs two delivery vans. This month the small van drove 300 km on each of its 16 working days, using 9 liters of diesel per 100 km. The large van drove 125 km on each of its 21 working days and normally uses 16 liters per 100 km, but on 9 of those days it carried heavy loads and used 25% more fuel than normal. The small van is 6 years old. Diesel costs $1.68 per liter. Each working day starts at 8 a.m. How many liters of diesel did the two vans use altogether this month?

Kofi needs 14 sketchbooks and 8 sets of paints and will buy the whole order at one of two shops. At Bright Mart, a sketchbook costs $8 and a set of paints costs $22 with no discount on the bill, but every fifth sketchbook in an order is free. Last month Bright Mart had 30% off everything. At 6 p.m., the upper tank contains 530 liters of water and the lower tank contains 706 liters. Each tank can hold up to 900 liters. Water from the mains costs 2 cents per liter. From 6 p.m. on, a valve drains the lower tank at 180 liters per hour, and a crack in the upper tank leaks 3 liters per minute. 7 minutes after 6 p.m., a hose starts filling the upper tank at 11 liters per minute, while the crack keeps leaking.
